name: Envelope
description: Small-business payroll. Persistent company records and payroll access are partial; calculation, payments and filings are not implemented.

externals.why: Owner-controlled Worker hosting and D1 storage. The owner supplies account authority and holds installation bindings; company private records use the independent payroll record key. Optional native email uses only the configured account and credential. See ./docs/payroll-external-data.md for custody.
data: configured native authentication mail when Cloudflare mail is selected

externals.why: Owner-opted-in redacted tax-notice proposals only; never payroll calculation or approval

Configured native sign-in, invitation and sensitive-change mail, plus exact human-approved notice correspondence. Installation mail credentials stay in owner Worker bindings; company notice credentials are encrypted in D1. Resend holds delivery data under owner terms.

Alternative explicitly configured native authentication mail transport. The owner supplies the API credential in installation bindings; SendGrid holds messages and delivery metadata under owner terms. No payroll record or private identifier is needed.

Optional owner-linked identity issuer, selected and reviewed in native sign-in settings. Discovery, token, key and link endpoints stay on the approved issuer origin. Installation signing keys stay in owner D1; only signed client assertions leave. Identity processing follows the selected issuer terms.
data: client identifier and signed client assertion

deploy.notes: Native owner sessions guard /app; unknown paths return real 404s; development and demo mail is suppressed.
